sections.title: BOSE 121
sections.overview:
121:   49,800(2sets, sold in November 1992)121V :   55,000(2sets, around 2000)

This small speaker system was developed by integrating 11.5cm full-range unit technology.There are 2types of variations of 121and 121v for 121, and I could choose 2types of vertical and horizontal.Also, 121can be step-up to 363by combining with 242.Equipped with 11.5cm cone type full range unit D-222for all band.A special plastic is used for the frame part to prevent the magnetic field of the magnet from being magnetized to the frame, thereby improving the operation of the magnetic circuit for the voice coil and preventing magnetic disturbance. In addition, energy is extracted efficiently by adopting a shape that smoothly extracts back pressure of corn paper.The cone paper contains mica, which is a mixture of layers of mica broken into fibers, to improve the response to the input signal by increasing the internal loss while maintaining the reality of the sound. The mica is characterized by increasing the hardness of the cone paper and increasing the response to the signal, but it is difficult to suppress the secondary mobility. The Bose is characterized by increasing the internal loss and suppressing the secondary mobility while maintaining the high rigidity of the cone paper by studying the mixing ratio to the cone paper and the materials. This realizes clear playback with good response over a wide bandwidth. In addition, the high-frequency characteristics are improved by adopting a unique curved shape.Glass fiber is used for the center cap to achieve a smooth high-frequency response.A new rubber-based edge is used for the edge part to improve response to a pulsed input signal and high-frequency characteristics.The helical voice coil uses an edgewise winding, and thanks to the introduction of a computer, an aluminum ribbon wire with a ratio of 4: 1in length and width is wound on the bobbin with precision and no gap. As a result, a strong magnetic field and high input resistance are achieved.Plastic foam is used for the damper.The cabinet is made of MDF, which is high in height and density, and is approximately 1.5times stronger than conventional particle boards, reducing unnecessary noise. While most MDF is a mixture of broad-leaved and conifer trees, the 121uses 100% of carefully selected conifer trees to enhance acoustic sound reproduction.In addition, the side panel is made of bird'Ωs eye maple with UV paint finish to give it a luxurious feel.An aero-flare port is used for the bass reflex port.By adopting the slit shape of this port, the peak of the reproduction sound due to the resonance of the port is suppressed, and the energy from the back of the unit is effectively utilized. In addition, before and after the pose, a newly designed aero-flare port which makes full use of hydrodynamics is installed, and by controlling the large amount of air and speed necessary for low sound reproduction, the port noise is suppressed, and the turbidity of low sound is eliminated.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated screw terminal that can be used with banana plugs or thick wires.The 121comes with a mounting plate for brackets that can be combined with Bose rich brackets.

sections.title: BOSE AM-033
sections.overview: A subwoofer developed for the 101series and 1111series.The AM-033consists of a speaker and a dedicated network box.AM-033adopts the original Kusu timas theory (US PAT. 4549631).This system uses Bose'Ωs unique acoustic filter effect. The Woofer unit is mounted inside the cabinet and the acoustic energy is radiated outside in resonance with the mass of the air inside the port. Therefore, even if mid-range energy or strain occurs inside the cabinet, resonance does not occur because the frequency energy is different from the resonance frequency of the air inside the port.With this system, high-quality bass can be obtained, and the installation position can be freely chosen by filtering out high-frequency distortion that gives a sense of direction of the sound source.In the acoustic theory, all acoustic energy is emitted through ports arranged in front and back of the Kusu.This port is tuned to different frequencies before and after the woofer unit, so that near one tuning frequency, there is little output from the other port, and both outputs are multiplied between tuning frequencies, resulting in a wide range of flat bass.The unit is equipped with a 13cm cone shaped woofer with a highly responsive edge and damper.This unit uses a dual voice coil system. Two independent voice coils are wound simultaneously on one core to directly input both left and right channel signals.The cabinet has a cylindrical shape, and by matching the center of gravity of the structure with the center to receive the pressure of acoustic energy, generation of unnecessary resonance and standing wave is suppressed.It is made of lightweight and heat-resistant polycarbonate, making it possible to use in environments (below 120  C), such as car interiors in mid-summer.In consideration of the adverse effects on sound quality due to vibration and resonance, the AM-033uses a box-type network that is independent of the speakers.In addition, a dedicated one touch coupler is used for the output terminal to easy wiring.A special simple stand is included.In addition, various settings are possible by the separately sold ceiling / wall mounting bracket and stand.
